## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes # https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/4570

---

## 📝 Summary
The session_affinity.py created closable pubsub entity without close. 
Fix: 
```
    pubsub = redis.pubsub()
```
replaced with 
```
   async with redis.pubsub() as pubsub: 
```
The other changes in this file were introduced by pre-commit.

reviews.author: Lang-Akshay
reviews.body:
Thanks for the PR @dima-zakharov 
This PR switches Redis pubsub usage in session affinity to async context managers to ensure pubsub connections are closed. 
Please update the test to assert close/exit behavior. 

### Test Quality — 🟡

| # | Test File | Test/Line | Issue | Recommendation |
|---|-----------|-----------|-------|----------------|
| 1 | `test_session_affinity.py` | `test_session_affinity.py:972-994` | Pubsub fakes expose `close()`/`closed`, but tests do not assert the close/exit behavior that prevents leaks. | Add assertions that the pubsub mock is closed or `__aexit__` is exercised in the relevant forwarding/listener tests. |
